scientific_integrity: The first quotient and genus of the original curve are cited prior results. The second-quotient model, genus and characteristic-three modular map are proved from rational invariants, fixed points and exact Weierstrass identities. No independence or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Odd prime-power q only; lambda excludes ±1; smooth projective normalization of quotient affine model; j map only for \(q=3\). No automorphism-group classification of the quotient; no claim of absolute priority among all degree-six maps.
title: Klein-four quotients of a nonlinear-invariant plane-curve pencil
